facts.text: Operating since 1987, St. Lawrence's First-Year Program (FYP) is one of the oldest living-learning programs in the country.

sources.title: First Year Program | St. Lawrence University
sources.quote: Our First-Year Program (FYP) is one of the oldest living-learning programs in the country, helping students make successful transitions from high school to college, intellectually and socially, since 1987.

facts.text: St. Lawrence University requires all undergraduate students to live on campus for their entire college experience.

sources.title: Mission and Philosophy - St. Lawrence University
sources.quote: St. Lawrence University requires all undergraduate students to reside on-campus for the whole of their University experience.
